Deep in the volcano region (Mount Obsidian). Heat protection gear is strongly recommended for the journey.

The faction leader fights alongside their partner Pal. Know what you're up against.

How to beat it

  • Recommended level 30; Orserk is a Dragon/Electric powerhouse, so bring strong counters.
  • The volcanic region has tough wild Pals — travel with a good flying mount.
  • Hard mode is level 55 and hits much harder.
  • Winning normal mode still counts toward unlocking hard mode for all towers.

Frequently asked questions

Where is the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Tower in Palworld?

The Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Tower is located in Mount Obsidian, at map coordinates (-587, -517). Open your map and head to those coordinates to reach the tower entrance.

What level should I be for the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Tower?

The recommended level is 30. Hard mode raises the boss to level 55, so bring a team that can survive a much tougher fight.

Who is the boss of the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Tower?

The tower is guarded by Axel & Orserk. Bring Pals that can counter a Dragon / Electric-type opponent and keep your own team's levels close to the recommendation.

What is the hard mode level for the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre Tower?

Hard mode is level 55. The fight is the same tower, but the boss hits harder and has more health, so upgrade your gear first.
